notes.title: The Mammoth now in 25 languages!
notes.content:
Woah! That's a lot of languages! Thanks to all of our wonderful community translators for submitting their work!

Many of the new languages aren't supported by Steam, but you can choose your language in-game, from this huge list:

[list]
[*]Arabic
[*]Basque
[*]Belarusian
[*]Bulgarian
[*]Catalan
[*]Chinese
[*]Czech
[*]Danish
[*]Dutch
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Hebrew
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Mongolian
[*]Polish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Serbian
[*]Spanish
[*]Thai
[*]Turkish
[*]Ukrainian
[/list]

notes.title: A Mammoth language update
notes.content:
The Mammoth now has subtitles for the following additional languages:
[list]
[*]Italian
[*]Russian
[*]Thai
[*]Danish
[*]Bulgarian
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Japanese
[*]Basque
[*]Turkish
[*]Catalan

Thanks to everybody who helped contribute translations! We at inbetweengames are very grateful. If you'd like to help, check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/751690/discussions/0/1488866180591964915/]this forum thread[/url]
